title: Thank you again Adelina!
text:
We cannot say enough wonderful things about Adelina!  She was the BEST tour guide we ever had!  So friendly, knowledgable and FUN!  We highly recommend asking for Adelina for any tour her company offers!
Thank you again Adelina!
Kevin and Laura
author: W6310XEkevinm

title: Sagrada Exterior
text: I did both the indoor and outdoor tours of Sagrada with the same company and I definitely recommend them.
